scope: Keyboard selection of nested content blocks; publication verification recorded separately

reproduction.action: Open the GDP source disclosure, focus its summary, then use Alt+Shift+A
reproduction.observed: The selection covered the whole GDP card instead of the focused disclosure title
reproduction.qualification: The initial browser keyboard action reported a focus-command timeout; the resulting dialog, selection and snapshot were subsequently observed. The reported selection dimensions come from the actual rendered DOM.

changes: Select the closest semantic content block, including nested paragraphs, headings, table rows, data definitions, images and disclosure summaries
Make nested content keyboard-focusable while retaining existing persistent content IDs and semantic fingerprints
Expose the shortcut through aria-keyshortcuts and preserve explicitly assigned focus order
Use the physical A key as well as the character so macOS Option-modified characters work
Ignore composition, repeat, unrelated modifier combinations, input/editable fields and the annotation UI

realPage.keyboardAction: Browser keyboard input with Alt, Shift and A after focusing the source summary
